replayRule: Work on a copy of the frozen before sample. Load using the real harness --session <copy>, or supply the sample's selected branch through the existing S1 native surface. Do not overwrite the committed historical input or replace it with output written by the migrated implementation. Use the literal expectations above; freshly generated new-write/new-read smoke is supplementary only.
counterexample: An implementation that starts off instead of restoring true will enable on the next toggle, produce the wrong notice and append true instead of false. An implementation that selects another session's branch loses the target's init and activation.
